source.title: The Lost Saplings
source.description:
In times of unrest, seeds may take root in bitter soil. Ancients born this way are prone to corruption. They wander hostile lands; never finding peace.

I have sensed four saplings who may be spared such a fate. They are lost among the Eastern Kingdoms, with leaves like that of each season.

Please, take this water to them, so that they may be healed.

Be warned, the water's magic is delicate. Teleportation will destroy it. Its potency will also fade over time.
source.objective:
Find the four lost saplings in Eastern Kingdoms, and share the Water of Elune'ara with them. Afterwards, return to Orokai, in Moonglade.

Provided item:
source.progress: Make haste, <name>. My kin may yet be saved.
source.completion: Your deeds have preserved centuries of life, <name>. I am immensely grateful. May you bring yet more healing upon this land in the times to come.
